finalText: Migration finished. All 12 straggler modules (`session.js`, `macroAdmin.js`, `sla.js`, `couponService.js`, `teamService.js`, `apiKeyAdmin.js`, `refund.js`, `variantAdmin.js`, `returnService.js`, `supplier.js`, `cohort.js`, `shipment.js`) now call `db.execute({ sql, params })`. `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` and the `cache.query` calls were left untouched, and `verify.js` confirms every module still loads and works.
